name: Shadow Order raises Shadow Brand damage and converts Agility into hit rating (#980)
contract: Shadow Order rank 2 681486 (installed Spell.dbc, client set of 2026-09-17) is a passive family-21 spell with effect 0 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) op 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT) mask [1] 0x10000400 base 39 die 1 -> +40%, effect 1 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT (220) misc 224 (bits 5, 6, 7 = CR_HIT_MELEE, CR_HIT_RANGED, CR_HIT_SPELL) MiscValueB 1 (Agility) base 5 die 1 -> 6%, and effect 2 which is a second copy of effect 0 (op 22, the same mask). The Description reads 'Increases the damage of Shadow Brand and Dawn Blade by 40% and your hit rating by 6% of your Agility.' Shadow Brand 680517 carries SpellFamilyFlags[1] 0x10000000, so the DOT modifier reaches it; the duplicate effect means it is applied twice and, because op 22 percent modifiers multiply (Player::ApplySpellMod), Shadow Brand gets about +96% instead of +40% (Dawn Blade, family flag [0] 0x400, is not matched by either copy). This scenario therefore asserts only what is unambiguous: the periodic-damage modifier must be at least the promised +40% (min 1400 from a base of 1000) and the control must stay at 1000, and the hit-rating half is measured as a slope: Increased Agility 40 (14404, +40 Agility) must add 6% of 40 = 2.4 hit rating, so 2 or 3, on all three hit ratings. The exact modifier value and the Dawn Blade half are reported to the maintainer instead of asserted.
